a.lede: Cybersecurity company Radware says attackers gained access to some of its customers' account details and cloud access keys through an unsecured internal Cloud WAF (Web Application Firewall) management API that was left exposed online. [...]
a.title: Radware discloses breach exposing customer cloud access keys

b.lede: 1Password assures customers that their logins and other sensitive information were not compromised in a recent data breach.
b.title: 1Password says it was hacked but users' vaults are safe
